documents.title: Fictional Alder Parcel: damaged delivery claims
documents.text: Alder Parcel is a fictional delivery cooperative. Its current customer policy took effect on 15 March 2026. A recipient who discovers visible damage must submit the claim form within seven calendar days after delivery. Attach photographs of the outer carton, the shipping label, and the damaged item. Keep the packaging until the claim is resolved. Staff acknowledge a complete submission within two business days; this is an acknowledgment target, not a promise of reimbursement. A sender may file on the recipient's behalf using the tracking number. The policy does not state a maximum compensation amount or a reimbursement deadline.

documents.title: Fictional Alder Parcel: retired claims instructions
documents.text: This archived Alder Parcel leaflet applied to deliveries made before 15 March 2026 and has been replaced. It instructed recipients to report visible damage within thirty calendar days and to bring the damaged item to a staffed depot. Photographs were optional under that procedure. Depot staff would give the recipient a paper reference number and forward the report to the regional claims desk. The leaflet was retained for historical reference so staff can explain older correspondence. Its thirty-day reporting window and depot-only submission instructions must not be used for deliveries governed by the current policy.

documents.title: Fictional Mere Library: after-hours collection lockers
documents.text: Mere Library, a fictional public library, offers collection lockers outside its east entrance. When a reserved book is ready, the member receives a six-digit collection code by email. The code remains valid for seventy-two hours from the time that email is sent, including weekends. A member who cannot visit in that period can request one additional forty-eight-hour hold before the original code expires. Staff confirm extensions by email. Oversized books and reference-only volumes cannot be placed in lockers and must be collected at the desk during opening hours. This notice provides no information about borrowing fines.

documents.title: Fictional Juniper Clinic: appointment reminder preferences
documents.text: Juniper Clinic is a fictional outpatient practice. Patients may choose SMS reminders, email reminders, or both through the reception team. Reminder messages are normally sent forty-eight hours before an appointment. To stop SMS reminders while keeping email reminders, ask reception to remove only the SMS preference; cancelling one channel does not cancel the appointment or the other channel. Reception verifies the patient's name and date of birth before making the change. Replies to automated reminder messages are not monitored. Appointment cancellations must be requested by telephone. This communication policy does not describe clinical treatments, medical fees, or cancellation charges.

documents.title: Fictional Foundry Rooms: member guest access
documents.text: Foundry Rooms is a fictional shared workspace. A member may bring up to two guests on a weekday between 09:00 and 18:00. Register each guest at reception on arrival and remain on site throughout the visit. Guests may use the lounge and a meeting room reserved by their host, but may not use the members-only fabrication workshop. Guest access is included in membership and does not include an independent door credential. On Saturdays and Sundays, visitors are admitted only for events explicitly marked as public. The policy does not specify how many meeting-room hours a membership includes.

documents.title: Fictional North Quay Museum: accompanied visitor entry
documents.text: North Quay Museum is a fictional local history museum. A museum member may bring two guests without paying general admission on weekdays from 09:00 until 18:00. The member must show a membership card at the front desk and stay with the guests during their visit. Free guest entry covers the permanent galleries, but separately ticketed temporary exhibitions require their own tickets. No guest names need to be submitted in advance. Weekend guest visits require ordinary admission tickets unless a named public event advertises free entry. This visitor notice does not cover workspace access or meeting-room reservations.

documents.title: Fictional Bramble Bikes: loan battery returns
documents.text: Bramble Bikes is a fictional bicycle hire shop. Customers who borrow a spare e-bike battery must return it to the staffed counter before 17:30 on the final day of their hire. Batteries must not be left in the outdoor key-return box because that box is not designed for electrical equipment. If a customer expects to arrive late, they should telephone the shop before the counter closes to arrange a return on the next working day. The shop lends a protective sleeve with each battery and asks customers to return both together. This instruction sheet gives no battery capacity, range estimate, or charging duration.

documents.title: Fictional Cedar Pantry: container refill procedure
documents.text: Cedar Pantry is a fictional refill grocery. Customers may bring clean, dry containers for rice, oats, lentils, and coffee beans. Before filling, place the empty container on the counter scale so staff can record its tare weight on a removable label. At checkout, staff subtract that recorded container weight from the filled weight, so the customer pays for the product alone. Containers that are wet, cracked, or visibly dirty cannot be accepted. The shop supplies paper bags for customers without suitable containers. Customers with allergy questions should ask staff to inspect the relevant product label; this procedure makes no allergen-free guarantee.
